verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE page says it produces an automated post-mortem built from the incident timeline and Slack discussion, which is the core of this story. AI-suggested Linear tickets for fixing the root cause loosely cover follow-ups. Support rests on single-line marketing claims, so the depth of the drafts is unknown. Missing for 10: explicit coverage of contributing factors in the draft, a documented human review/edit workflow, postmortem-specific docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
